summary: Fixes in the Planar Surface operation: removes the GapThreshold property, relabels the Keep tool down threshold task-panel field and drops its mm unit, rewrites the KeepToolDownRatio and KeepToolDownThreshold property descriptions, changes which contextual properties are hidden in Waterline versus Z-Level mode, corrects the MinSampleInterval limit message, and fixes several Z-Level/Adaptive toolpath bugs that do not change documented behaviour.

pages.reason: Path/Op/PlanarSurface.py and PageOpPlanarSurfaceEdit.ui: the operation whose properties and task panel change here (GapThreshold removed, KeepToolDownThreshold/KeepToolDownRatio descriptions rewritten, 'Keep tool down threshold' label with no unit, MinSampleInterval limit 0.001-25.4 mm) has no page

Path/Op/PlanarSurface.py: GapThreshold property removed from opPropertyDefinitions/defaults/SetupProperties; KeepToolDownRatio description now 'multiple of the tool diameter'; PageOpPlanarSurfaceEdit.ui label 'Keep tool down ratio' -> 'Keep tool down threshold', unit mm dropped; CutPatternAngle no longer hidden with the SurfaceScan-only group

Path/Op/PlanarSurface.py setEditorProperties: F group now 'hide if is_waterline' instead of 'hide if is_zlevel', so the contextual properties flip visibility between Waterline and Z-Level modes; GapThreshold removed and _executeWaterline uses a fixed 0.005 tolerance; MinSampleInterval error message now states 0.001 mm lower limit

adaptive_common.py and surface_zlevel.py: parameter normalisation, vertRapid fix, per-layer finishing_profile copy and planar-face test are internal generator fixes; the Area page does not describe them
